capture.note: Session-state & governance lifecycle events (E9, #96). plugin_loaded is a genuine live capture: claude 2.1.273 was run against a loopback OTLP sink in an isolated HOME with a scaffolded local plugin (claude plugin new), and it emitted plugin_loaded at startup with the attributes reproduced verbatim here (the CLI itself collapses a third-party plugin's name/marketplace to the literal 'third-party' and pre-hashes plugin_id_hash, and the run required no authentication so no API call was made). permission_mode_changed and auth could not be elicited in a scripted run — permission_mode_changed needs an interactive TUI mode toggle (shift_tab) or a model-driven exit_plan_mode, and auth needs an interactive OAuth login/logout (the `claude auth logout` subcommand flushes no OTLP auth event). Their attributes are reproduced from the 2.1.273 binary's own event-emit code, verified verbatim: permission_mode_changed => {from_mode, to_mode, trigger?} (emitted only when from!=to; triggers shift_tab/exit_plan_mode/auto_gate_denied/auto_opt_in; modes default/plan/acceptEdits/auto/bypassPermissions), auth => {action, success:String, auth_method, error_category?, status_code?:String} (last two only on failure). Values sanitised: synthetic session id, no user identifiers.

observations.name: permission_mode
observations.evidence: permission_mode_changed carries from_mode/to_mode and an optional trigger; a transition into bypassPermissions is the governance red flag and every tool decision is framed by the mode in force

observations.name: auth_lifecycle
observations.evidence: auth carries action (login/logout), success, auth_method, and on failure error_category/status_code

observations.name: plugin_inventory
observations.evidence: plugin_loaded (live-captured) carries plugin.scope, enabled_via, pre-hashed plugin_id_hash, has_hooks/has_mcp/host_owned_mcp, skill/command/agent path counts, and safe_mode
